characters.description: Salvation's distant master and a continuing enemy of Earth. His connection to Salvation leaves Zac concerned that the planet may be exposed to a far greater threat.
characters.name: Great Redeemer

characters.description: The leader of a mountain monastery who asks to meet Zac while Zac is recovering.
characters.name: Monastery Abbot

characters.description: Port Atwood's leader and a powerful dual-class combatant. While recovering from a broken arm, he prepares an expedition into the Underworld and continues directing Earth's defense against the undead.
characters.name: Zac

characters.description: A powerful karmic cultivator summoned by the monastery's monks. He is the abbot's master and one of many incarnations formed from the divided soul of the original Lotus Emperor.
characters.name: 84th Incarnation of the Lotus Emperor

characters.description: Zac's disguised undead identity for the Underworld expedition. The cover presents him as an unidentified and dangerous Port Atwood expert working alongside the Tal-Eladar while concealing Super Brother Man's involvement.
characters.name: Mr. Black

characters.description: Zac's demon partner and an experienced Port Atwood commander. He is recovering from Salvation's soul attack while helping plan the Underworld expedition and the permanent Mystic Realm gate.
characters.name: Ogras

characters.description: Zac's sister, an array specialist and elemental cultivator. She reports on Port Atwood's war effort while developing fire, earth, water, and air-aligned Dao insights.
characters.name: Mackenzie Atwood

characters.description: A trusted Valkyrie commander who knows the truth behind Zac's Mr. Black disguise. She helps organize the mixed Port Atwood force and joins the first party sent through the unstable Underworld connection.
characters.name: Joanna

characters.description: Port Atwood's merchant and a Thayer Consortium contact. He approaches the Tal-Eladar as prospective trading partners and aims to draw future Underworld commerce through Port Atwood.
characters.name: Calrin

characters.description: The wealthy controller of Underworld Nexus, known for arrays, treasures, and an extensive commercial network. Zac's party initially seeks him as the independent power governing the neutral town.
characters.name: Smaug

characters.description: A young Port Atwood fighter searching for members of her family. During the assault on a Union transit camp, she recognizes one of the captives as a former schoolmate from Allentown.
characters.name: Emily Larkin

characters.description: An Allentown survivor enslaved at a Union transit camp. Emily recognizes her among the captives after Zac's force seizes the facility.
characters.name: Camilla

characters.description: Smaug's sister, held by the Union as leverage against him. Ogras finds her while Zac's party investigates the Union's trafficking operation.
characters.name: Rima

characters.description: A Port Atwood demon commander and poison specialist. She directs a trapped war camp, maps the undead hordes' suspicious movements, and orders a breakout when teleportation is blocked.
characters.name: Alea

characters.description: A demon general serving as a frontline leader in Port Atwood's campaign against the undead. He helps organize the army's forced escape after its base and teleportation route are cut off.
characters.name: Ilvere

characters.description: Zac and Kenzie's missing mother. A technocrat scanner reacts to her amulet and labels its owner a sought traitor, suggesting that the hidden incursion may be following traces she left behind.
characters.name: Leandra

characters.description: A technological entity bound to Kenzie's mind. It can analyze advanced devices, believes the Mystic Realm wall is technocrat-made, and seeks unfamiliar technology to further its own development.
characters.name: Jeeves

characters.description: A Port Atwood illusion specialist supporting the army's breakout. His deceptions help cover an assault on the elite undead force blocking the survivors' route.
characters.name: Janos

characters.description: The technocrat foreman leading the hidden camp. Sivis withdraws toward the Nexus Hub with four hired cultivator bodyguards while Zac and Ogras dismantle the camp's machines.
characters.name: Sivis

characters.description: A swift Marshall war leader who hunts the controller undead directing the zombie hordes. Her targeted strikes disrupt enemy coordination while the living armies struggle to hold their sectors.
characters.name: Thea Marshall

characters.description: A Tal-Eladar healer who joins Zac's search for Port Atwood's missing army. She travels with the rescue group and eight Valkyries assigned to protect Kenzie.
characters.name: Tilia

characters.description: A purifier allied with a displaced force. Her divine energy is especially effective against undead, and she works with the Valkyries to repel spectral attackers and stabilize Alea.
characters.name: Sui

characters.description: The Undead Empire commander overseeing the array intended to realign Earth toward death. After learning that Zac has rescued Port Atwood's army, he keeps the larger conversion plan in motion.
characters.name: Lich King

characters.description: The Tal-Eladar leader and beastmaster whose people joined Zac's Underworld operations. She remains in the Underworld when Zac's group leaves to search for Port Atwood's missing army.
characters.name: Verana Tir'Emarel

characters.description: An Allbright Empire cultivator who has spent months near the Tower of Eternity. He approaches Zac and Ogras with local knowledge and an eagerness to form a connection, though his purpose is initially uncertain.
characters.name: Galau

characters.description: A Zethaya alchemist authorized to negotiate over the Prajna cherry, a treasury treasure that may repair Alea's soul. He asks Zac for rare intelligence, research material, or a demanding service in exchange.
characters.name: Boje Zethaya

characters.description: A Tsarun clan cultivator with a prior claim on the Prajna cherry. He recognizes Zac through the Thayer Consortium license dispute and deliberately obstructs Zac's effort to secure the soul treasure.
characters.name: Rasuliel Tsarun

characters.description: The identity Zac registers under when entering the Tower of Eternity. He chooses his mother’s apparent former surname in the hope that the name will draw her attention.
characters.name: Zac Piker

characters.description: The Beroria family member who traveled through the Tower of Eternity under the cover name Galau. After leaving Zac and Ogras, he takes over an oasis shop and opens Beroria Goods and Treasures with goods secretly collected during the climb.
characters.name: Beroria
